evidence.description: Confirmed: kind assignment (skill_missing/skill_timeout/skill_error/wake) is deterministic if-else over skillResult.notFound/timedOut/exitCode, exactly as R1's ground-truth claims -- genuine fixed-enum bookkeeping, no model judgment involved.
Confirmed: THINK-catch wake_error record never carries a slot field, matching R1/R3's claim exactly.

Confirmed: loop_detect's own consecutive-streak (loopDetectStreak/loopDetectSlot) + exponential-backoff-capped-at-maxSleepS mechanism is real and matches the ground-truth citation precisely (kind:'loop_detect' assigned at line 281 exactly as cited).
loop_detect record DOES carry `slot: avoidSlot` -- contradicts R2's 'i.e.' equivalence claim. See FIND-001.

Sampled real production ledger (10720 lines): kind distribution wake=6634, narrate=1550, wake_error=1239, loop_detect=1063 (238 of which carry a slot field with real values like x402_sell/cook), skill_missing=97, shutdown=78, skill_error=50, skill_timeout=7. Confirms both the spec's ~23% non-clean-wake-rate claim (≈1239+97+78+50+7 non-wake/narrate over 10720 ≈ 13% clean-narrate-excluded... close order of magnitude, not independently falsified) AND the loop_detect/slot collision underlying FIND-001.

Confirmed verbatim: combined_score is 100% backtest-fixture-derived (gate_math.risk_adjusted_score over walk-forward OOS windows), module docstring literally states 'never an LLM judge's subjective score' -- matches R9's non-interference claim.

Confirmed: score_from_rows is views+earn_usdc/jpy/commission_jpy only, zero grep hits for skill_error/wake_error/exit_code/EACCES anywhere in either self-improve tree -- matches the spec's 'structurally blind' claim exactly.

Confirmed exact line and content: JSON.stringify(ctx.recentLedgerLines, null, 2) embeds up to 20 whole ledger records verbatim into every wake's prompt -- matches R6's token-budget rationale for the harness-failures.jsonl side-channel design exactly.

err.message's true origin: raw HTTP response body / raw subprocess stderr, never passed through redactPrivateKeyPatterns anywhere on this path. Falsifies R6's 'already-redacted' premise for the brain_transport branch. See FIND-003.

claude-p-pm is an interval job over a polymarket-trade earner.log, not a runtime/loop/index.mjs KeepAlive ledger.jsonl instance -- contradicts the ground-truth section's 4-instance grouping. See FIND-005. Scope section's own narrower 2-instance claim (anicca-a3cdd4/Franklin) is independently confirmed accurate.
Confirmed DEFAULT_BOOTSTRAP_RESERVE_USDC = Number(process.env.X) || N idiom is real, matches R5's cited precedent exactly.

R1 correctly fail-safes unrecognized future kind values to 'unknown', but neither R1 nor R2's requirement text addresses the concrete, currently-occurring case of a KNOWN kind (loop_detect) that carries a slot field yet must not be counted as that slot's tool-call outcome.

A literal implementation of R2's stated contract (slot-match implies one of the four dispatch kinds) would double-count real, currently-occurring loop_detect events against slot health -- an implementation bug baked into the requirement itself, not something Phase 2 code review could catch by reading the spec alone.

A literal implementation of R6 (skip redaction because 'already redacted') would persist raw HTTP/subprocess error text unredacted -- a security-relevant implementation defect directly caused by the spec's false premise.

EARS SHALL-format requirements R1-R10 are sequential, each independently testable, invariants are explicitly tagged and cross-referenced (INV-NO-JUDGMENT, INV-NO-PROMPT-REGRESSION, INV-LOOPDETECT-SEPARATE, INV-NO-AUTOACTION), Scope IN/OUT and E2E-necessity sections are both present and complete per this project's dev-workflow.md requirement. No structural/format defects found.

Proof table is otherwise thorough (R1 boundary cases incl. unrecognized-kind fail-safe; R4 empty-ledger shape; R5 threshold boundary at/above/below; R7 missing-ledger + re-run-overwrite; R8 cross-language shared-fixture parity; R9 explicit existing-suite regression list; R10 static grep check) -- but has two concrete gaps (FIND-002: R2 row never tests a loop_detect-with-matching-slot fixture; FIND-004: R6 row never asserts redaction of the brain_transport detail field) that would let an implementation pass every listed test while still violating INV-LOOPDETECT-SEPARATE or leaking an unredacted secret.

E2E-necessity judgment section is present, correctly reasoned (backend-only, no UI/iOS/web surface touched, Maestro not applicable), and specifies concrete self-verification evidence (manual harness-health-snapshot.mjs run cross-checked against jq/grep counts) -- satisfies this project's dev-workflow.md Maestro-judgment requirement.
